criteria.note: The opening paragraph names all seven restaurants and immediately flags which single one is a dedicated kitchen, satisfying the keyword intent well inside 200 words.
Title is 54 chars with the appended site name, description is 154 chars, keyword present, and no phrasing is duplicated between the two.
Headings carry the argument rather than labelling it, so a skim of the headings alone reconstructs the thesis.
Eight place pages plus four guide links, each placed where a reader would want the next step.
All three FAQ answers trace to visible body passages, including the exact four-dated-plus-one-undated visit accounting.
Dated repeat visits, a photographed certification mark, a specific lunch order, a re-checked HTTP 500, and an explicit list of questions the author failed to ask.
Named products and certifications, the exact Korean menu wording, hidden-source terms in Hangul, and a citable legal instrument make the claims checkable.
The regulatory claim links the primary statute with its instrument number and in-force date, and the closure evidence cites a dated Korean blog post plus a dated site check.
An explicit 'Honest limits' section states what the method cannot establish, the unvisited entries are labelled as menu-reading rather than testing, and there are no affiliate links.

findings.quote: **Not visited — but the menu carries a gluten-free course.**
findings.why: Every other unverified entry carries a check date and source (Vegetus: 'listed on the shop's own menu, checked September 2026'), but the Jihwaja menu claim has no date and no link, so a reader cannot verify the one fact that earns it a slot on the list.
findings.fix: Add the check date and the source for the gluten-free course, e.g. 'listed on the restaurant's reservation page, checked September 2026', with a link if one exists.

findings.quote: Monil2 House is a dedicated GF bakery-and-cafe rather than a sit-down restaurant, but with 237 Pizza closed it is the anchor of this list.
findings.why: The title and keyword promise restaurants, yet the single Tier 1 recommendation is a bakery-cafe, which may read as a partial bait for a user searching for a meal. The body is transparent about it, but the SERP snippet is not.
findings.fix: Work the caveat into the description, e.g. note that the only dedicated kitchen is a bakery-cafe, so the expectation is set before the click.

findings.quote: ask about 보리 and 맥아 by name — a "no wheat" answer does not cover them
findings.why: Hangul-only terms give a reader something to point at but no way to say or search them; the surrounding English sentences romanise other terms (hanjeongsik, Ssal Tongdak), so the treatment is inconsistent.
findings.fix: Either gloss these consistently with the rest of the piece or keep them Hangul-only throughout, and consider a copyable phrase line for the two barley terms.

criteria.note: 모든 주장이 출처 또는 자체 관찰로 표시돼 있으나, 미방문 Jihwaja의 GF 코스 주장만 확인 시점·경로가 없다(Vegetus에는 'checked September 2026'이 붙어 있어 대비된다).
criteria.evidence_quote: Not visited — but the menu carries a gluten-free course.

criteria.note: 제품명·수치·날짜는 서로 맞고 Tier 1 산술(7곳−폐업 1 = 6, 그중 FEEKE 창원 → 서울·경기 5)도 일치하지만, description의 '월 표기' 약속이 본문의 월 미기록 1건과 어긋나는 사소한 불일치가 있다.
criteria.evidence_quote: Five we ate at, two we did not — each entry says which, with the month.

criteria.note: 각 항목이 근거 종류(방문+월 / 미방문 메뉴 표기)로 시작하고, 메뉴 읽기는 성분 확인이 아니라는 한계와 묻지 않은 세 가지까지 명시한다.
절대적 안전 보증이 없고, 공용 튀김기·전처리면 교차오염을 해당 항목마다 다루며, NCGS와 셀리악을 명시적으로 분리해 셀리악 위험을 축소하지 않았다.
웹 확인(2026-09-08 HTTP 500), 블로그(2026-09-03), 메뉴 확인(2026-09), 시행규칙 시행일(2026-01-01)이 모두 날짜와 함께 제시되고 경과에 따른 변질 위험도 명시적으로 경고한다.
의무 표시가 밀만 해당하고 보리·('rye')는 아니라는 핵심 사실, 근거를 시행규칙 별표2로 지목한 점, 보리·맥아·보리차·간장·튀김옷·쌀통닭 등 용어와 행정동-구 대응이 모두 맞다.
별표2 직결 링크, 폐업 근거 URL, 매장별 한국어 주소·문구 페이지, 직원에게 물을 단어(보리·맥아·공용 튀김기)까지 독자가 스스로 확인할 수단을 준다.

findings.quote: Five we ate at, two we did not — each entry says which, with the month.
findings.why: 본문은 방문 5곳 중 1곳(Ssal Tongdak)을 'Visited, month not recorded.'로 명시하므로 description의 '각 항목에 월이 붙는다'는 약속과 어긋난다. 안전 판단에는 영향이 없지만 메타데이터와 본문이 불일치한다.
findings.fix: description을 'four with the month, one undated' 식으로 고쳐 본문 서술과 일치시킨다.

findings.quote: Not visited — but the menu carries a gluten-free course.
findings.why: 미방문 항목인데 '메뉴에 GF 코스가 있다'는 근거의 확인 시점·경로(매장 웹메뉴/전화/현장 사진 등)가 없다. 같은 미방문인 Vegetus는 'listed on the shop's own menu, checked September 2026'로 명시해 기준이 엇갈린다.
findings.fix: Vegetus와 동일하게 확인 경로와 월을 붙인다(예: 'listed on the restaurant's own course menu, checked September 2026').

findings.quote: A short walk from Hongik Station.
findings.why: 해당 역의 정식 명칭은 홍대입구역(Hongik University Station)이며 'Hongik Station'이라는 역은 없다. 연남동-홍대입구역 위치 관계 자체는 맞아 길 찾기를 그르칠 정도는 아니다.
